tldr: Lilith in the 8th house: raw sexuality, power, and the taboo
body: Lilith in the 8th house: raw sexuality, power, and the taboo. A strong placement. Where you reclaim desire, depth, and what was shamed. Watch: control, obsession, merging that overwhelms. Raw power in intimacy, trust, and shared resources; you refuse to be controlled in the deepest places. An all-or-nothing charge around intimacy and shared resources: either powerfully alive or shut down and refused. Strong affinity for the hidden and the taboo.
business: Unflinching about money, sex, and power when owned.
shadow: Control, obsession, or repeating the betrayal wound.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Imported from approved project Black Moon Lilith house material. Source file was not copied into the repository.
